notes: Every Claude account a one-year token, held by every host: minted in-app from the grant or the stored claude.ai session, filed only under the account the token names, converted in one go, renewed before it lapses. What `claude setup-token` does, read off the Claude CLI 2.1.301 binary (aliax-core 8b01168 has the mint): the ordinary code exchange for the Claude Code client plus `expires_in: 31536000` in the token-exchange body, and the same field on a refresh_token grant; both answer with the account. New src/main/aliax/staticMint.ts: the browser half in a throwaway partition seeded with the account's stored claude.ai cookies (login.ts's appSession), the consent URL with the static scopes, PKCE and a random state, the code read off the callback by path; a hidden run answers needs-sign-in on a login page or after 45 s, a visible run is the ordinary in-app sign-in with the address pre-filled; the approve button is clicked once per page when its label says so. New src/main/aliax/staticTokens.ts: one account at a time, the refresh grant first (no browser; the grant is dropped only once the token is verified and filed), then the stored session, then the sign-in window when the user asked; `user:inference` alone asked for when `user:profile user:inference` got no year; a token response naming no account is filed only when the session says whose it is; convertAll walks every row not yet static and every token inside its last 30 days with run progress; renewDue runs on boot and every six hours and tries a failed renewal at most daily; every mint ends in a sync to the other hosts. The accounts snapshot carries `mint` (per-row state, the run) for the Claude rows: the Accounts page shows "Making a one-year token", "Sign in to renew its one-year token · Sign in" and a failure with its reason on the row, "Convert all to one-year tokens" (or "Convert N") in the Claude panel header with the run's progress, and the row menu keeps the single-account action; the footer says "sign in again in Aliax to renew its one-year token" for the shown account; the typed-email dialog and the pty `claude setup-token` runner are gone (the token response names the account, so nothing is filed by what was typed). accountSync.ts activateIfNothingLive: a renewed static token of the account that is live on a host (the box) replaces the older one, so the live sign-in follows renewals; another account's static token is filed, not made live; a sign-in the host refreshes itself is never replaced. aliax.ts exports providerUrl for the fake-provider rewrite the mint window uses. Seams for isolated instances: TEMP_CODE_STATIC_RENEW_FIRST_MS / _EVERY_MS, `aliax:static:renewNow`, and aliax-core's ALIAX_CREDENTIAL_BACKEND=file + CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR so the Claude CLI's credentials live in a file inside the instance's data. Tests: staticMint.test.ts (7), staticTokens.test.ts (11), accountSync.test.ts (+2). Proof: scripts/e2e-static-tokens.ts (28 checks: three accounts converted through their grants, one falling back to user:inference, the usage poll on both kinds, a renewal through the stored session against the fake consent page, a lapsed session marked needs-sign-in, the peer's copies turned static and its live sign-in following the renewal). docs/box.md and CLAUDE.md say so.
